about: query-table's application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk10-descending-encoded-ascending
mutants.rule: Encode writes the sorting's direction (law EncodeDecodeRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fk10-period-not-encoded
mutants.rule: Encode writes the period filter (law EncodeDecodeRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fk10-bad-direction-keeps-column
mutants.rule: A sorting with a direction Decode cannot read is unsorted (law InvalidParamBecomesDefault).

mutants.name: fk10-sorting-extra-parts
mutants.rule: A sorting of more than column and direction is unsorted (law InvalidParamBecomesDefault, the near miss Name:Ascending:x).

mutants.name: fk10-any-path-is-the-table
mutants.rule: Only the root is the table (law OnlyTheRootIsTheTable).

mutants.name: fk10-last-param-counts
mutants.rule: Decode reads the parameters (law EncodeDecodeRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fk10-plus-not-a-space
mutants.rule: A + in the query is a space (case tour: search=a+b).

mutants.name: fk10-click-other-keeps-direction
mutants.rule: A click on another column starts it ascending (law ClicksCycleTheSorting).

mutants.name: fk10-descending-click-sticks
mutants.to:
if d.Column == c {
			return Descending{Column: c}
mutants.rule: A third click on a column unsorts (law ClicksCycleTheSorting).

mutants.name: fk10-search-case-sensitive
mutants.rule: The search ignores case (case tour: SAURUS).

mutants.name: fk10-diet-filter-ignored
mutants.rule: The diet filter keeps that diet only (cases tour and badscript; RowsAreTheMatches reads Matches, so it cannot see this).

mutants.name: fk10-weight-by-length
mutants.rule: Weight sorts by weight (case tour: sort Weight).

mutants.name: fk10-descending-unstable
mutants.from: slices.SortStableFunc(kept, func(x dino.Dinosaur, y dino.Dinosaur) int { Compare(d.Column, y, x) })
mutants.to: slices.Reverse(slices.SortStableFunc(kept, func(x dino.Dinosaur, y dino.Dinosaur) int { Compare(d.Column, x, y) }))
mutants.rule: Descending ties keep the listed order, as a flipped order does, not a reversed one (law RowsAreTheMatches).

mutants.name: fk10-lost-controls-kept
mutants.rule: On a path the table is not at, a control starts from the defaults (law UrlIsAFunctionOfTheControls).

mutants.name: fk10-control-moves-state
mutants.rule: Emitting a replacement URL leaves the route unchanged until host navigation (TableOnlyNavigatesOrRequests; not-run-crunch).

mutants.name: fk10b-open-at-first
mutants.from: Stay[Box]{Next: Box{..b, Open: true, Active: within(b, p.Selected)}}
mutants.to: Stay[Box]{Next: Box{..b, Open: true, Active: within(b, p.Selected*0)}}
mutants.rule: An opening list makes the selected item active (case scenes: the diet list opened again on Herbivore).

mutants.name: fk10b-pick-keeps-open
mutants.from: Emit[Box, []Effect]{Next: Box{..b, Open: false}, Output: []Effect{Selected{Index: p.Index}, Focus}}
mutants.to: Emit[Box, []Effect]{Next: Box{..b, Open: true}, Output: []Effect{Selected{Index: p.Index}, Focus}}
mutants.rule: A pick shuts the list (law OnlyAPickSelects; law AListChoiceIsTheTableChoice; cases).

mutants.name: fk10b-escape-selects
mutants.to: Emit[Box, []Effect]{Next: Box{..b, Open: false}, Output: []Effect{Selected{Index: b.Active}, Focus}}
mutants.rule: Escape shuts the list with no choice (law OnlyAPickSelects; case scenes: Escape after Home).

mutants.name: fk10b-active-past-the-end
mutants.rule: The active item stays in the list (law ActiveStaysInTheList).

mutants.name: fk10b-no-focus-back
mutants.rule: The focus goes back to the button of the list chosen in (law AListChoiceIsTheTableChoice; cases: focus Period).

mutants.name: fk10b-period-off-by-one
mutants.rule: A period list's item is the period it names (law AListChoiceIsTheTableChoice; cases).

mutants.name: fk10b-arrow-up-goes-down
mutants.rule: ArrowUp moves the active item up (case scenes: key ArrowUp from Omnivore).

mutants.name: fk10b-header-says-descending
mutants.rule: A header's name says its sorting, as upstream's aria-label (cases: sorting Length ascending).

mutants.name: fk10b-kilograms-grouped-by-four
mutants.rule: A weight groups its thousands, as toLocaleString (cases: 1,300 kg).
